moves.label: Trade: Josh Hart, Daniel Diez, Bojan Dubljevic, Ryan Arcidiacono, Svi Mykhailiuk and others
moves.description: Josh Hart, the draft rights to Daniel Diez and the draft rights to Bojan Dubljevic were acquired by the New York Knicks in exchange for Ryan Arcidiacono, Svi Mykhailiuk, Cam Reddish, the draft rights to Ante Tomic and a conditional 2023 1st round pick (NYK own). Svi Mykhailiuk, a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a More Favorable 2027 2nd round pick and a TPE were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for Jalen McDaniels and a 2024 2nd round pick (NYK own). Jalen McDaniels, a 2024 2nd round pick (NYK own), a 2029 2nd round pick (POR own) and a TPE were acquired by the Philadelphia Sixers in exchange for Matisse Thybulle and a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick. Ryan Arcidiacono, Cam Reddish, Matisse Thybulle, the draft rights to Ante Tomic, a conditional 2023 1st round pick (NYK own) and a TPE were acquired by the Portland Trail Blazers in exchange for Josh Hart, the draft rights to Daniel Diez, the draft rights to Bojan Dubljevic, a More Favorable 2027 2nd round pick and a 2029 2nd round pick (POR own).

moves.label: Roster move: Greg Brown III
moves.description: The Portland Trail Blazers placed the contract of Greg Brown III on waivers.

moves.label: Trade: James Wiseman, Saddiq Bey, Kevin Knox II, Saddiq Bey, Gary Payton II and others
moves.description: James Wiseman was acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Saddiq Bey and Kevin Knox II. Saddiq Bey was acquired by the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for a conditional 2025 2nd round pick (ATL own), a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a conditional 2024 2nd round pick (ATL own), a 2026 2nd round pick (ATL own), a 2028 2nd round pick (ATL own) and a TPE. Gary Payton II, a 2026 2nd round pick (ATL own), a 2028 2nd round pick (ATL own) and a TPE were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for James Wiseman, a conditional 2026 2nd round pick (MEM own) and a 2028 2nd round pick (GOS own). Kevin Knox II, a conditional 2025 2nd round pick (ATL own), a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a conditional 2024 2nd round pick (ATL own), a conditional 2026 2nd round pick (MEM own), a 2028 2nd round pick (GOS own) and a TPE were acquired by the Portland Trail Blazers in exchange for Gary Payton II and a TPE.

moves.description: Damian Lillard was acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Grayson Allen, Jrue Holiday, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a 2029 1st round pick (MIL own) and a Swap 2030 1st round picks. Grayson Allen, Keon Johnson, Nassir Little, Jusuf Nurkic and a TPE were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Deandre Ayton and Toumani Camara. Deandre Ayton, Toumani Camara, Jrue Holiday, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a 2029 1st round pick (MIL own), a Swap 2030 1st round picks and a TPE were acquired by the Portland Trail Blazers in exchange for Keon Johnson, Damian Lillard, Nassir Little, Jusuf Nurkic and a TPE.
